events.text: The task log says the live steps already ran. I'll check the live state myself before I move the task.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read live centre lane settings and lane.ts commits

events.name: Bash
events.head: Grep lane settings and lane status endpoint
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/settings 2>&1 | grep -E '"(tantra_lane[a-z_]*|tantra_sender|tantra_test_emails|tantra_seed_list)"' | cut -c1-250; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/lanes 2>&1 | head -c 800

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read both lane campaigns from Tantra via proxy
events.input: $ grep -n "tantra-proxy" cloud/src/*.ts | head -5; for id in 6acc0c7f5f16ab824d7a3487 6acc0c805f16ab824d7a34a1; do python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py POST /admin/api/tantra-proxy "{\"method\":\"GET\",\"path\":\"/email-campaigns/$id\"}" 2>&1 | grep -oE '"(name|status|selectedSenderAccountIds|error)": ?("[^"]*"|\[[^]]*\])' | head -5; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check test attendees 125 and 126 state
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/attendees 2>&1 | grep -oE '\{[^{}]*"id": ?12[56][^{}]*\}' | grep -oE '"(id|email|revoked|status|test)": ?[^,]*' | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect proxy allowlist and attendee output
events.input: $ sed -n 455,480p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-220; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/attendees 2>&1 | grep -nE 't061(free|paid)' | head; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/attendees 2>&1 | head -c 300

events.text: The proxy path is the URL itself, not a body field. Running both checks again with that fixed:

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read campaigns via proxy URL and test attendee flags
events.input: $ for id in 6acc0c7f5f16ab824d7a3487 6acc0c805f16ab824d7a34a1; do python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/tantra-proxy/email-campaigns/$id 2>&1 | grep -oE '"(name|status|selectedSenderAccountIds)": ?("[^"]*"|\[[^]]*\])' | head -3; done; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/attendees 2>&1 | sed -n '170,215p' | grep -E '"(id|email|revoked|test)"'
